title: 木
teacherNotes: Release verified and merged L279 from origin/codex/l279-complete-package against latest origin/main. Dependencies are satisfied in playable order through L287; R001-R016 are already shipped.

generationConstraints.allowedBoundary: Release verified against production JSON through L279.
usageNotes: Do not use the unlearned character for building-block compound terms.
Images may show wooden toys and wooden bridge pieces, but no visible text, numbers, labels, or zhuyin.
imageRules: All images must be square image / 1:1 composition.
Use L058 only as illustration style references, not people appearance references.
Use protagonist family continuity from LESSON_VISUAL_CAST_SOP and ledger.

approvedSentences.imageNotes: Protagonist little girl builds one wooden bridge at home or in a play area using toy or safe craft materials; no text, numbers, labels, or zhuyin.
A construction worker safely uses wood to build a house; show worker, wood, and house building clearly; no text, numbers, signs, labels, or zhuyin.
Protagonist little girl at a table tries to open a wooden box, but the wooden box is stuck and will not open; no text, numbers, labels, or zhuyin.
A small dog lives in a cozy little nook under a bridge, with the protagonist little girl watching from a safe distance; warm fairy-tale feeling, not poverty; no text, numbers, labels, or zhuyin.
Wooden toys are on the back seat of a parked car; protagonist little girl looks at or safely reaches toward the toys; no license plate, text, numbers, labels, or zhuyin.

notes: G02 target is the first Han character, so prefix text is empty and prefixSrc is omitted per CURRICULUM_PRODUCTION_SOP; suffix audio is generated from exact suffix text.
